description: Start an interactive Chromium session and return its session_id. Sessions keep console and network history; stop them with browser::sessions::stop when done.

headful.description: Force a visible window for this session, overriding the configured `headless` default.

read_only.description: Inspection-only session: act, evaluate, execute, and styles::write are rejected while navigation, snapshots, reads, and screenshots work. Immutable for the session's lifetime.

url.description: URL to open immediately. Omit to start on about:blank.

session_id.description: Pass this to every other browser function.
